faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes. ArtisanVoice has a full offline mode. You can create and edit documents without a connection. As soon as your network returns, everything syncs automatically.
faq.q2: What language can I dictate my invoices in?
faq.a2: You can dictate in French. Support for other local languages (Wolof, Bambara, Mooré…) is under development.
faq.a3: Your data is encrypted and hosted on secure servers in Europe. We never access the content of your invoices and you can delete your account at any time.
faq.q4: How does the Pro subscription work?
faq.a4: The Pro subscription is monthly at 5,000 FCFA. It gives you access to unlimited documents, client management and priority support. You can cancel at any time with no fees.
faq.q5: Can I use ArtisanVoice on my phone?
faq.a5: Yes! ArtisanVoice is a Progressive Web App (PWA) optimized for mobile. Add it to your home screen for a native app experience, without going through a store.
faq.q6: Is there a free trial of the Pro plan?
faq.a6: The Free plan is available without time limit. To try Pro, contact our team — we offer a trial period on request.
